Fonts are bundled from the Google Fonts project and served locally.
Each font's SIL Open Font License 1.1 and copyright notice are in assets/licenses/.

Manrope: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/manrope
Sora: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/sora
Outfit: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/outfit
DM Sans: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/dmsans
Fraunces: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/fraunces
Plus Jakarta Sans: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/plusjakartasans
IBM Plex Mono: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/ibmplexmono
